name: Eurozone HICP
consensus_source: Trading Economics page for euro-area inflation, market expectation for the September 2026 flash (not a Reuters/Bloomberg poll, unconfirmed)
read: HICP yoy 3.75% vs 3.6% consensus (unconfirmed) and 3.23% prior, a 3-year high led by energy. Core 2.5% was in line. Hawkish for ECB path and EUR, bunds; adds pressure on equities.
